subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Ace in the Hole
email_body:
Hi Rhett,

I came across your recent releases, including Ace in the Hole from 2025 and the An Unexpected Hero light novel series, and I was struck by how far your work ranges from hard science fiction to LitRPG and graphic novel projects.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Ace in the Hole is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, from concept to finished files. It is entirely optional and can sit alongside the feature or stand on its own, whichever suits you.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Ace in the Hole best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
